tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder/Agency must attach Yellow Board Registration Certificate
Bidder/Agency must attach difference amount DD from Nationalised bank or Scheduled bank in the name of Municipal Commissioner,CMC Rabkavi-Banahatti
Bidder/Agency must attach previous three years IT Return copy FY 2023-24 2024-25 2025-26
Bidder/Agency must attach work done certificate providing similar nature of services to any Govt. Offices obtained from competent authority
Bidder/Agency must attach valid certificate for Tourist Vehicle
Bidder/Agency must attach valid Current Insurance copy
Bidder/Agency must attach valid PAN Card
Bidder/Agency must attach Vehicle permit copy
Bidder/Agency must attach all the documents mentioned in attached tender document
Bidder/Agency must attach Drivers valid driving license
Bidder/Agency must attach Tax Card copy
